title: Hard bound: fallback-byte reduction after CPU batch microprobe rejection

cpu_microprobe_bound.decision: CPU batch or microkernel tuning remains below the 10 tok/s bound even when paired with perfect source/page overlap, unless another mechanism removes additional fallback bytes/calls.

resident_exact_hotset_bound.fit_status: does_not_fit_while_preserving_gate_cache; also has negative zero-overhead slack
first positive 10 tok/s bound, but raw payload alone does not fit with current gate cache/workspace; even cpu_moe=41 plus the measured extra pool is insufficient before workspace

vram_implication.decision: Top3072 would require a large gate-cache sacrifice and still misses 10 tok/s before overhead. Top4096 needs more than the recoverable extra-pool budget and cannot be promoted without a new VRAM-footprint breakthrough.

source_streaming_bound.decision: Source streaming or io_uring-only work is not a 10 tok/s route. It can hide some cold source/page time only if paired with a separate exact bytes/calls removal mechanism, and same-op touch/parallel source work has already regressed.

candidate_decisions.reason: Best measured exact hot replay is 74.719 GiB/s source-payload, below the zero-overhead 90.643 GiB/s requirement.

candidate_decisions.candidate: raw exact topN up/down residency under current VRAM shape
candidate_decisions.reason: Top3072 does not fit and still misses 10 at zero overhead; Top4096 first crosses 10 but needs 17 GiB raw payload before gate/workspace.
Measured direct read throughput is orders of magnitude below the required effective source-payload bandwidth and source-only overlap has a sub-10 ceiling.
Prior audits already closed pure placement sweeps; any placement candidate must quantify exact bytes/calls removed, VRAM recovered, and TTFT impact before benchmarking.

next_required_breakthrough_class: Recover enough VRAM or reduce model/workspace/gate footprint so that at least a top4096-equivalent exact up/down hotset can fit without destroying gate-cache savings.
Find an exact/token-stable representation that reduces up/down payload by roughly 4x-6x beyond raw MXFP4 packing for the hotset, because generic compression samples were only about 1.04x.
Remove fallback bytes/calls at the routing/model level with a written proof that the France fixed-text top1 remains exact before any strict cold benchmark.
immediate_next_action: Do not write new runtime source for CPU batch, source-only streaming, or raw topN residency. If continuing implementation, first write a VRAM-footprint/payload-reduction breakthrough plan with a hard bound above 10 tok/s and enough overhead slack.
